ui-widgets.description: Fix DatePickerField clipping, transient Toplevel popups, form widget consistency. Delegates when tasks involve widgets.py, date pickers, form fields, or calendar popups.

ui-performance.description: Fix scroll jank, tab refresh storms, lazy loading, polling. Delegates when tasks involve active-tab-only refresh, pausing hidden polling, or reducing nested CTkScrollableFrame.

company-details.description: Company Details panel and sub-tabs. Handles lazy sub-tab build and scroll architecture in company_details/.

worker-api.description: skyadmin-worker/ routes, sync, license, D1 database. Handles Worker routes, Vitest, wrangler deploy patterns.

desktop-core.description: services/, db/, sync, export, license logic. Business logic and SQLite; keeps UI thin.

qa-verifier.description: After UI or API changes, pre-ship. Runs pytest/vitest/release_check, reports pass/fail (read-only).

packaging-release.description: Builds, installer, CI, version bumps. PyInstaller, Inno Setup, release_check.py, GitHub workflows.
